task_completion.description: Agent opens the GMAT application and reads the mission specifications from the desktop memo.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the GMAT GUI open and the content of 'ephemeris_request.txt' displayed in a text editor.

task_completion.description: Agent configures the Lunar Polar Mapper (LPM) spacecraft with Moon-centered MJ2000Eq coordinate system.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT 'Spacecraft' or 'Orbit' panel showing 'Coordinate System' set to a Moon-centered MJ2000Eq frame.

task_completion.description: Agent sets the propagation duration to 7 days and the step size to 60 seconds.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT 'Propagate' command or 'Propagator' settings showing a duration of 7 days (or equivalent seconds) and a step size of 60.

task_completion.description: Agent sets up the EphemerisFileWriter resources for both OEM and SPK formats with the specified file paths.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT resource tree or configuration panels showing an EphemerisFileWriter for 'lunar_dsn.oem' and another for 'lunar_science.bsp' in the GMAT_output folder.

task_completion.description: Agent executes the script/mission to generate the trajectory data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT 'Message Window' showing a successful run completion or the 'Run' button being pressed followed by a progress bar.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the GMAT script to the specified location and verifies the output files exist.
task_completion.visual_evidence: File explorer or terminal showing 'lunar_dsn.script' in ~/Documents/missions/ and the .oem and .bsp files in ~/GMAT_output/.

integrity.description: The agent used the GMAT graphical user interface rather than just creating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent clicking buttons and typing in the GMAT GUI panels.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually create the .oem or .bsp files using a text editor to fake results.
integrity.visual_evidence: The output files are generated through the GMAT 'Run' process, visible in the GMAT console output.

integrity.description: The agent entered the specific mission parameters (7 days, 60s step) into the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent actively inputting '7' and '60' into the GMAT configuration fields.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The mission requires a 7-day duration at a 60-second step size, which results in exactly 10,081 data points in the OEM file. The coordinate system must be Moon-centered MJ2000Eq. Output paths: Script to ~/Documents/missions/lunar_dsn.script; OEM to ~/GMAT_output/lunar_dsn.oem; SPK to ~/GMAT_output/lunar_science.bsp.
